candidates.name: Keratoacanthoma
support_spans: Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
contradict_spans: Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present
candidates.why: The presence of a hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts could suggest keratoacanthoma, but the malignant features and mitotic activity argue against this diagnosis.
candidates.protected_reason: Keratoacanthoma is a rare and sometimes difficult to distinguish from squamous cell carcinoma, making it a potential minority diagnosis.

candidates.protected_reason: This variant is rare and may be overlooked due to its unusual histological features.
